producer_report.summary: The explainer page now has a skip link, a CSS-only core/expert switch (a checkbox before main), a learning-path ordered list of every section, `:focus-visible` and `prefers-reduced-motion` rules. Only Counters and Transitions are expert. Claims, glossary and next steps stay visible in the core track, so no citation link is dead. The nav sits directly under the header, and with_evidence now inserts after it. The decisions page gets only the skip link and a main id. A new test renders both tracks and fails on a dead anchor or a hidden claims section. OLY-B-D2-02 in docs/spec.toml now names site.rs with `status: not shown`. CHANGELOG.md and the design doc are updated.

checks_run.note: 83 tests incl. track_tests; fixed two decisions tests that counted hrefs

checks_run.command: cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast -p xtask -p athena-core -p athena-cli --test policy --test mirrors --test site_page

criteria_check.criterion: docs/spec.toml requirement OLY-B-D2-02 has a mechanism that names xtask/src/site.rs instead of "none", owner Athena, and a measure that ends `status: not shown` and names the test that shows it (a diff line in docs/spec.toml).
criteria_check.evidence: docs/spec.toml OLY-B-D2-02: mechanism names xtask/src/site.rs, owner Athena, measure names no_track_has_a_dead_anchor_and_the_features_exist and ends 'status: not shown'. Policy and full tests pass.

criteria_check.criterion: xtask/src/site.rs page wrapper and CSS contain a skip link to the main content, a core/expert track control with expert content marked, a learning-path ordered list covering every section, including those that have an id, an `@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)` rule and a `:focus-visible` style. The existing viewport meta and `prefers-color-scheme:dark` rules remain.
criteria_check.evidence: finish() emits skip link, checkbox#track-expert, nav#learning-path ol built by number_sections() over every <section (ids kept, e.g. next-steps, about-this-page); CSS adds the rules; viewport and dark rules kept. Asserted in track_tests.

criteria_check.criterion: The claims section and the glossary are not hidden by the track CSS. Only sections marked class expert are hidden in the core track, and the header sentence saying the claims are listed at the end stays true.
criteria_check.evidence: EXPERT_SECTIONS = Counters, Transitions only; test asserts one display:none rule (.expert) and that Claims, Glossary and Next steps h2 remain in the core view, and 'listed at the end' text present.

criteria_check.criterion: A new unit test in xtask/src/site.rs renders the real page in each track (core default and expert ticked). It fails if any in-page `href="#..."` points to a missing id or to an element inside a hidden expert subtree, or if a section the header names is hidden. Run `cargo test -p xtask site`. It passes with the change and fails if claims_section is marked expert.
criteria_check.evidence: track_tests::no_track_has_a_dead_anchor_and_the_features_exist passes (cargo test -p xtask). marking_the_claims_section_expert_would_be_caught shows marking claims expert leaves dead core anchors.

criteria_check.criterion: A second assertion in that test checks each feature exists in the rendered HTML: skip link, track control, learning-path list, reduced-motion rule, focus-visible rule. Run `cargo test -p xtask site`. The existing site tests, including the job-evidence ordering test, still pass or are updated consistently.
criteria_check.evidence: Same test asserts each feature. Job-evidence ordering test updated to '</nav><section id="job-evidence">' and passes; with_evidence inserts after the nav.

criteria_check.criterion: `cargo test` passes, `cargo clippy --all-targets` is clean, and `cargo fmt --check` passes (cite the commands that ran, or the Athena checks recorded on the final tree).
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks; I also ran cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast -q (exit 0), clippy -D warnings (clean), cargo fmt --all.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has a new entry for this change, and docs/design/explainer-site.md describes the tracks, the learning path and the rule that no track has dead links, without claiming features that the decisions page lacks.
criteria_check.evidence: CHANGELOG.md Unreleased/Added entry; explainer-site.md two new bullets, stating the decisions page only gets the skip link and shared CSS.

open_issues: The job-evidence section is inserted after the nav, so the learning path does not list it.
mistakes: First draft of the claims-expert negative test asserted a string with a trailing space; corrected before the run.
learnings: Decisions-page tests count href= occurrences, so the skip link required updating them.
The Bash hook rejects heredocs, pipes to tail and cd; use Edit for appends.
